title: Topic 9
japanese_text: 警察が事件解決に<u>苦心する</u>こと10年。会社員が突然<u>消息</u>を<u>絶った</u>事件の真相がようやく明らかになりそうだ。犯人がついに<u>観念し</u>、別れ話が<u>もつれて</u>殺したと<u>白状した</u>のだそうだ。
english_translation: The police were struggling to solve the case for ten years. It looks like the truth behind the missing whereabouts of the company employee will finally come to light. The murderer finally accepted his situation and confessed that he killed the woman because they had gotten mixed up in a breakup.
